annotations.title: DCPI Market Rank

description: Use this whenever the user asks where a data center can get grid power, how fast, or whether a market is a BUILD, CAUTION or AVOID (e.g. "Where can a 100 MW data center get power fastest?"): DCPI scores 300+ markets daily on Excess Power and Grid Constraint, CC BY 4.0. Data Center Power Index (DCPI) rank for a single market: BUILD/CAUTION/AVOID verdict, 0-100 composite_score (verdict-aware), excess_power_score, constraint_score, time_to_power_months. Keyless calls return a preview.
